claim: PJM issued a second mandatory Pre-Emergency Load Management Reduction Action at 16:00 EPT on October 13, 2026. Message 105562 dispatched Capacity Performance demand-response registrations with Quick_30 lead time across 20 zones, adding RECO to the zones already covered by message 105561. The posting requires reductions to continue until PJM releases them.
falsifier: A corrected or withdrawn PJM primary posting showing message 105562 was a drill, was not issued, did not apply to Quick_30 Capacity Performance demand response, or did not add RECO would contradict the recorded operational delta. Delivered relief remains separately untested.
firstUnsupportedArrow: Mandatory Quick_30 dispatch issued -> Curtailment Service Providers received registration-specific instructions -> selected participants complied -> telemetry verified delivered megawatts -> the grid received usable relief.
omissions: Selected registrations and facility identities are not public in the posting.
Expected and delivered megawatts are not stated.
CSP receipt, participant compliance, telemetry validation, failures and penalties are not stated.
The release time is not yet stated.
The posting does not distinguish direct load reduction from workload migration or self-generation.
No Emergency Use of Back-Up Generator Warning or Action is shown in the retrieved posting.
No later George v. Rollins docket state or discovery-to-application signal was established in this finding.
failures: Registration-specific DR Hub records were not accessible through the public posting.
No public performance record was retrieved to establish actual megawatt delivery.
rivalHypotheses: PJM expanded dispatch because earlier 60-minute and 120-minute resources were insufficient or system conditions worsened.
The 16:00 action was a staged product-specific dispatch triggered by Quick_30 timing and availability, not evidence that earlier resources underperformed.
RECO's addition reflects product-registration geography rather than a new local reliability deterioration.
notes: This candidate records an operator instruction, not completed performance, avoided outage, backup-generator use, or customer migration.
CAN prepare and test the candidate; MAY to admit, merge, publish or act remains external.
